sql: SELECT SUM(il.unit_price*il.quantity) AS value FROM public.invoice_line il JOIN public.invoice i ON il.invoice_id=i.invoice_id JOIN public.track t ON t.track_id=il.track_id JOIN public.genre g ON t.genre_id=g.genre_id WHERE i.invoice_date>=DATE '2022-01-01' AND i.invoice_date<DATE '2023-01-01' AND g.name='Metal'
